description: Frozen golden for the versioned delayed deterministic regime grader (RegimeGraderSpec@1) consumed by grade_case/mature_pending_cases. policy is the reviewed model payload for human inspection; canonical_json is the exact sha256+cjson-v1 semantic canonical form; content_digest is its sealed digest (sha256 of canonical_json). Thresholds are provisional v1 values — tuning belongs to Phase 4 run_optimize over matured cases with the sealed-holdout discipline (plan D10), NOT here. NEVER auto-regenerated by tests: a change here is a reviewed policy change.
notes: window: entry = the first observed benchmark session strictly after the case's as_of session; a case dated on a non-session anchors to the previous session.
window: exit = the horizon_trading_days-th observed session after entry BY LIST POSITION (never calendar days); a holiday/suspension gap can never fake maturity.
maturity: an un-matured case (the exit session is absent from the observed list) yields CaseMaturityPending and no event — grading never happens before maturity.
forward_return = the product of (1 + per-session benchmark return) over (entry, exit], minus 1.
max_drawdown = the minimum running drawdown of the compounded wealth path (anchored at 1.0 at entry); it is always <= 0.
realized_volatility = the population standard deviation of the per-session returns in (entry, exit].
trend (R6 vocabulary, shared with the judgment TrendState): forward_return >= bull_min_return (0.03) => 牛; <= bear_max_return (-0.03) => 熊; otherwise 震荡.

risk: max_drawdown <= risk_off_max_drawdown (-0.05) => risk_off (drawdown precedence); else forward_return >= risk_on_min_return (0.02) and max_drawdown > risk_on_min_drawdown (-0.03) => risk_on; otherwise neutral.
heat: None in v1 with heat_unavailable_reason='no_realized_heat_definition_v1' (a realized-heat definition needs a temperature history Lane 0 does not yet own).

available_at of the graded outcome = the exit bar's availability time (a data-driven PIT fact, never a wall clock); data_snapshot_hash = the content digest of the exact (entry, exit] benchmark window graded.
